output_list.criticism: The function mintToken does not check if the addition of mintedAmount to balanceOf[target] will cause an integer overflow. This could lead to an incorrect balance for the target address.
The function setPrices does not check if the multiplication of newSellPrice and newBuyPrice will cause an integer overflow. This could lead to incorrect prices for token purchases and sales.
The function sell does not check if the multiplication of amount and sellTokenPerEther will cause an integer overflow. This could lead to incorrect token sales and transfers.
The function() payable public does not check if the multiplication of msg.value and buyTokenPerEther will cause an integer overflow. This could lead to incorrect token purchases and transfers.
The function() payable public does not check if the addition of totalContribution to tokensIssued will cause an integer overflow. This could lead to incorrect token purchases and transfers.
